units.description: France Archers have a bow. Inferior Fighters. Open Order. Levies. Every second unit may exchange bow for crossbow (+2).

units.name: Handgunners

units.name: Scots Guards
units.description: Scots Guards have hand-and-a-half sword (counts as Halberd). Shield, Partial Plate Armopur and longbow. Veteran. Riding Horses. Open Order. May be Stubborn (+2). The unit may not exceed three bases.
